title: Ran me gala kata diya moula hussain ne
body:
Ran me gala kata diya moula hussain ne
Sajde ka haq adaa kiya moula hussain ne
<<DIVIDER>>
Hur ki qataae'n baqsh di sibte rasool ne
dozaq se yu bacha lia moula hussain ne
<<DIVIDER>>
taareekiyo'n ka des thi ye arze karbala
sooraj use bana diya moula hussain ne
<<DIVIDER>>
karbobala se quld-e-baree'n do qadam pe hai
kya qoob ye pata diya moula hussain ne
<<DIVIDER>>
akbar ko ran me bhej diya aur chup rahe
Islam ko jila diya moula hussain ne
<<DIVIDER>>
asghar ko dafn kar diya dashte qitaal me
dil qaak me mila diya moula hussian ne
<<DIVIDER>>
qaime jale rida chine deene nabi rahe
zainab ko ye bata diya moula hussain ne
<<DIVIDER>>
'rehan aazmi' tujhe izzat hui naseeb
tu kya tha kya bana diya moula hussain ne
